product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic is an enterprise integration and applied-AI platform that connects applications, data, APIs, and AI agents and automates workflows for organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as a governed integration layer for applications, data, APIs, and AI agents.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes packages and pricing structure, although it directs visitors to request a demo for customized prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are named on SnapLogic’s customer stories page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company information identifies San Mateo, California, as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists 2006 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes technical posts on developer environments and SnapLogic’s internal analytics architecture. The E-Pods article identifies its author as a former Staff Software Engineer; the analytics-platform article identifies its author as a SnapLogic Software Engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple product-documentation areas, including product and AI/LLM documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current company job listings include engineering, forward-deployed, sales, accounting, and marketing roles, but none has an AI, ML, data-science, or other specified qualifying title. A search-result posting for Applied AI Architect returned a 404 when checked.

model_provider.value: SnapLogic publicly lists support for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini/GenAI, and Amazon Bedrock.
model_provider.notes: The homepage names multi-model providers; the documentation portal includes corresponding LLM documentation.

compliance_certs.notes: SnapLogic explicitly cites SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA/HITECH audits or compliance, and separately says its platform is GDPR compliant. The cited pages do not name ISO 27001 or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: SnapLogic announced a $165 million round in December 2021; Crunchbase identifies the round as Series H.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round identified in the company’s funding history was announced in December 2021, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers listings include Senior Enterprise Account Executive openings. An SDR posting surfaced in search but returned a 404 when checked; the AE openings establish the positive answer.

launched_6mo.notes: SnapLogic announced its October 2026 product release on 2026-10-22, within the six-month window. The release includes product and feature updates.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On 2026-05-12, SnapLogic appointed Molly Matthews President and announced promotions of Anjana Kashyap to Chief Customer Officer and Cassie Capano to Chief People Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named on SnapLogic’s integration/Snap Pack pages.
